q: we estimate the causal effect of adopting a widely popular LLM agent assistant, namely Cursor, on development velocity and software quality.
r: EC6: observational mining of GitHub repositories adopting Cursor (difference-in-differences), not a controlled comparison of agents on the same tasks.

q: we introduce ChatDev, a chat-powered software development framework in which specialized agents driven by large language models (LLMs) are guided in what to communicate (via chat chain) and how to communicate (via communicative dehallucination).
r: EC5: main contribution is a new multi-agent framework compared with GPT-Engineer and MetaGPT; the ad hoc metrics and dataset are secondary and there is no repetition or control design.
